task.title: feat: skip Copilot review request when existing review is newer than last commit
task.body:
## Summary

- Add `CheckCopilotReviewStatus()` method that fetches the PR head SHA and reviews in a single pass, determining both pending and fresh status
- Fresh check compares each Copilot review's `commit_id` against the current PR head SHA to determine if the review covers the latest code
- If Copilot's review matches the current head commit, skip requesting a new review and print "already up to date" message
- Consolidates the previous `HasCopilotPendingReview()` and fresh check into one API call to reduce rate limit usage
- Uses `gh api --paginate --jq '.[]'` with `json.Decoder` for correct pagination handling

## Test plan

- [ ] Run against a PR where Copilot has already reviewed the current head commit -> should skip with "already up to date" message
- [ ] Run against a PR with new commits after Copilot's last review -> should request a new review as usual
- [ ] Run against a PR with no Copilot reviews -> should request a new review as usual

instructions.line_numbers: All file line numbers refer to the head commit.
instructions.scope: Report actionable issues introduced or exacerbated by this PR. Do not report trivial style preferences.
